result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and a popular listing is missing its name/details.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is clipped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') and most of the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last visible card has enough padding or a peek, and allow wrapping/ellipsis so names remain fully readable.

issues.description: The lower popular listing (pizza with -20%) has no restaurant name, rating, or delivery metadata under the image.
issues.suggestion: Show the restaurant title, rating, time, and delivery info consistently like the ramen card above.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a cut-off next chip).
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and a clear scroll affordance so chips aren't hard-cut at the screen edge.

issues.description: The ramen restaurant name appears to lose its last letter ('Tokumaru Ramer' vs expected 'Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Check typography/overflow so titles aren't truncated mid-character.
